notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.5 - Changelog
notes.notes:
⚒️ Improvement 

 A step-by-step tutorial was created for new players, it will always appear on the day if you want to do it.


👾 Bugfix / Hotifx 

 The notification that was appearing behind the newspaper was fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.3 - Changelog
notes.notes: We fixed a problem caused by the last update.

notes.title: Update 1.2.3 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Hotfix 

 The error that was giving to some users when the critical character did not appear has been fixed.


 Bugfix 

 When the food truck closed the door with hamburgers on top of the counter, the door was on top of the burger.
 Adjustment of table purchase information.
 The score within the game is updated at once when the game continues, before it had a delay before reaching the total value.


 Improvement 

 The score is now updated on Steam at the end of a day.
